skills.title: Initialize and update counts by key
skills.competency: Maintain per-key counts under explicit initialization and update rules; distinguish first and repeated events, empty input and independent keys.

question_families.novelty_definition: Count each exact string token occurrence once. Empty input yields an empty mapping; repeated occurrences increment the same counter. Renamed tokens with the same frequency algorithm retain this family.

Process signed per-key adjustments chronologically, flooring count at zero after every event and discarding negative deficits immediately. Reordering events can change results; final-total clamping is insufficient. New family classification is AI-reviewed content evidence, not learner eligibility.
